---
format:
  html:
    body-classes: cover-page
bibliography:
  - bib/references.bib
  - bib/psha.bib
csl: bib/apa.csl
---

```{r}
#| include: true
#| results: asis
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "cover.R"))

ReportTitle <- params$title
ReportLanguage <- "en"
QuartoYml <- file.path(root, "_quarto.yml")
if (file.exists(QuartoYml)) {
  QuartoMeta <- yaml::read_yaml(QuartoYml)
  if (!is.null(QuartoMeta$book$title)) ReportTitle <- QuartoMeta$book$title
  if (!is.null(QuartoMeta$lang) && grepl("^es", QuartoMeta$lang)) ReportLanguage <- "es"
  if (!is.null(QuartoMeta$book$lang) && grepl("^es", QuartoMeta$book$lang)) ReportLanguage <- "es"
  AUX <- unlist(c(QuartoMeta$book$chapters, QuartoMeta$book$appendices))
  if (any(grepl("\\.ES\\.qmd$", AUX))) ReportLanguage <- "es"
  rm(AUX)
}

AUX <- trimws(as.character(c(
  ReportTitle, params$site, params$location, params$project_id
)))
AUX <- AUX[!is.na(AUX) & nzchar(AUX)]
if (length(AUX)) cat(sprintf("# %s {.unnumbered}\n\n", AUX[[1L]]))
rm(AUX)

ParamsCover <- params
ParamsCover$title <- ReportTitle
CoverHTML <- buildCoverReport(ParamsCover)
cat("```{=html}\n", CoverHTML, "\n```\n", sep = "")
```
